submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final production-ready seasonal event banner illustration for the Chinese Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: very wide landscape banner, target 2098 × 749 pixels, aspect ratio 2.8:1. Opaque edge-to-edge painting. Output only the independent banner artwork, never a full UI, never a contact sheet.
Reference image 1 (event-midautumn.png) is the PRIMARY approved painted-art, character, finish and horizontal composition reference. Reference image 2 (01-mail-event.png) is the approved mail UI style/context reference only: do not render any of its frame, controls, labels, text or panels.
Faithfully keep the same refined rounded cute Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: clean polished outlines, rounded full forms, delicate painterly fabric/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal mountains, ivory cloth, restrained warm gold details, clear depth, luminous but properly exposed highlights. This is richly finished 2D digital painting, not photorealism, not flat vector, not plastic 3D.
Main character stays on the RIGHT THIRD: same small chibi Taoist boy from reference, very large round brown eyes, round rosy face, short straight/spiky brown hair, pure golden headband with side knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory short robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd, big head/short limbs. Adjust only his pose and the small seasonal props to the stated theme. Keep one boy only. All face, hands, and principal props stay within safe edges.
Composition: preserve the useful wide email-banner balance. Keep LEFT 45% relatively quiet with low-detail softly layered lake, mist, sky and distant mountains, suitable for future title overlay; do not draw any letters there. Character and the most legible seasonal emblems occupy the right, with sparse corner foliage. Keep the seasonal symbols visually distinct without crowding.
Text: absolutely no Chinese characters, no English, no pseudo-writing, no numerals, no calligraphy, no watermark, no logo, no graphic frame or UI border. No mooncakes, no giant moon, no Mid-Autumn lanterns, no rabbit; those are only in the style reference, not this season.
Rendering target: the project's configured highest quality visual finish; host-managed built-in tool, no claim that prompt text sets model parameters.
Season-specific scene: Beginning of Summer solar term: clear bright early summer, fresh green lotus leaves and just-opening lotus buds near the right foreground of a quiet jade pond, distant Taoist pavilion and rounded green mountains. On the right the cheerful little Taoist boy holds a small colored thread egg pouch with one smooth cream egg, beside a shallow woven basket with two eggs and a few fresh green peas. Rich fresh greenery, gentle sunshine, young lotus buds, no mature lotus field or harsh midsummer heat.

Production clarifications for this rendition: adapt reference image 1 into this new seasonal scene while preserving its character identity and polished painterly finish. Reference image 2 contributes only the approved rendering/material language, never any UI pixels. Keep the natural scene edge-to-edge at approximately 2.8:1, requesting 2098x749 native pixels if supported; do not add letterboxing. The boy sits on a low rounded stone pond bank on the right, with both separate feet and shoes fully visible inside the canvas. His small hands naturally hold the egg pouch together: one hand pinches the soft hanging cord, the other gently supports the egg-filled bottom. Hands connect naturally to wrists, five anatomically plausible digits per hand (occlusion allowed), no extra fingers or fused hands, no floating props. The familiar small golden yin-yang gourd hangs securely from his belt. Near him is one shallow woven basket with two eggs, several green pea pods and a small cluster of red cherries, connecting the theme's egg-pouch and seasonal fresh-food motifs. Fresh small lotus leaves and two tender unopened/just-opening pink buds appear only around the right pond edge, with ample calm water and airy distant mountains on the left 45%. Gentle sunlight keeps ivory clothing, skin and sky textured with midtones; no blown highlights, no strong bloom. One unified illustration only.

visualInspection.method: 实际查看两张参考、工具生成画面及本地2098×749成图，按可见像素比较。

checks.theme: 彩线蛋袋内一枚浅色鸡蛋，小篮内两枚蛋、樱桃与豌豆；嫩荷叶、两枚粉色荷苞、晴朗绿荫表现立夏。
checks.style: 金发带短棕发、大眼圆脸、玉绿金边背心、米白短袍裤、腰间太极葫芦；细腻手绘体积与参考一致。
checks.face: 双眼、口鼻与耳朵清楚，无明显错位或重影。
checks.hands: 两手腕连接自然；上方手握蛋袋绳结，下方手托袋底。可见手指轮廓无明显多指、融合或断裂；握持和道具遮挡使全部五指无法逐根完整确认。
checks.feet: 两只独立鞋脚完整入画，短腿与坐姿连接自然，无额外脚。
checks.propContact: 提绳、托蛋袋、腰带悬挂葫芦与篮子落石台关系自然，无明显悬空道具。
checks.negativeSpace: 人物与核心节物集中右侧，左侧水面和远山形成安静可用区域；边缘少量荷叶和上方树枝不侵入主角色。
checks.noText: 未见文字、数字、伪字、水印、Logo、UI框或拼图。
checks.exposure: 明亮日光下皮肤、白衣、天空和金饰保留层次；湖面高光局部克制，无大范围过曝。
checks.safeEdges: 脸、双手、蛋袋、篮子与双脚均未被画布裁断。
